conclusions: U_i and J_i are exact for the frozen piecewise-linear Feddes functional when the current h3 is known, but the pair is not invariant to a change in h3.
The tested existing retained hydraulic state does not uniquely determine U_i and J_i.
For arbitrary demand-dependent h3, an exact forcing-portable non-tautological representation is threshold-queryable root-weighted pressure-head distribution information.
No useful exact low-dimensional forcing-portable root state has been established.

handoff.approximate_state_design_requires: Independent purpose-dependent fidelity/tolerance authority, or a prospectively frozen approximation hierarchy whose outcomes are reported without an acceptance claim.
handoff.permitted_research_without_application_t: Derive candidate-independent approximation families and error frontiers, but do not select a sufficient operational state from observed error.
handoff.prohibited: Do not fit a U/J surrogate to the S3 response, do not choose descriptor dimension from an observed application error threshold, and do not make a production or performance claim.
